content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's Degree in Physical Education (M.P.Ed.) or one year diploma in coaching from SAI/NSNIS with 15 years experience Age limit: Maximum 62 years (as on closing date of application) Age relaxation: max_engagement_age Maximum age during engagement shall ordinarily be 65 years Other conditions: Full-time contractual basis Desirable: Demonstrated ability to plan, coordinate and implement sports development programmes Demonstrated expertise in sports performance development and talent identification Recognized national or international sporting achievements

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for BBAU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants who have attained the age of 62 years on the closing date of application, subject to relaxation by the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Remuneration is negotiable and is decided on the applicant's last substantive position, pay level, qualifications, experience, achievements and the responsibilities assigned. Initially up to six months, extendable on the basis of satisfactory performance and institutional requirements

content_sections.heading: How Will BBAU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications Review of qualifications and experience Engagement of consultant based on review of qualifications, experience and criteria

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Educational and professional qualifications Experience certificates and details of positions held Retirement or superannuation certificate Evidence of coaching qualifications, sports achievements, awards Details of sports administration and infrastructure-development experience Proof of date of birth and identity Pension Payment Order (PPO), where applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBAU Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application proforma attached with the notification. Superscribe the envelope with Application for the engagement of Consultant (Level-I). Attach supporting documents for educational qualifications, experience, coaching achievements, and proof of date of birth. Send the application to the Registrar, Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Vidya Vihar, Raebareli Road, Lucknow-226025, UP. Make sure it reaches by 5 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The engagement will be purely on contract basis and appointment will not confer any right for regular appointment.
